info.name: Friendie Logistics API v1 — audited Phase 9
info.description: 37 verified routes. Isolated/synthetic testing only. Do NOT run this collection against the original database. Login is not deployable there until separately approved Sanctum table installation. No automatic token capture, mail trigger execution or test scripts. Listing DELETE is intentionally409. Dates/IDs/CAPTCHA/proofs/files must be replaced with synthetic isolated fixtures. Use base_url including /api/v1, no trailing slash. See FINAL_API_AUDIT_V1.md and FINAL_API_ROUTE_INVENTORY.md.
